title: Walker: 'How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?'

tellings.quote: remember Walker saying, "We're talking about MJ12. Oh, the the dead bodies." He said, "How do you know they're dead? You assume too many things and they're all wrong. How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?"

plain: In 1987, when Grant Cameron asked Eric A. Walker about the dead bodies said to be held by MJ12, Walker answered: "How do you know they're dead? You assume too many things and they're all wrong. How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?" Cameron is a UFO researcher, MJ12 is a secret panel said to have managed the UFO question for the US government, and Cameron says he heard Walker say it himself. If Walker meant it, the beings would not have been dead at all.
